query: What infrastructure & tools will USDA stand up?
response: The USDA will stand up a common infrastructure and toolset, including the USDA AI Lab, to enable mission-focused and high-impact AI use cases. Additionally, a hub-and-spoke model will be deployed, with the USDA AI Lab as the "hub" and Mission Area Innovation Incubators as the "spokes" to promote code sharing, pilot program development, and support research and development.
